initialization: fresh seed42 capacity384 random weights; never initialize from the old one-pass or diagnostic checkpoints

training.logical_objective: one positive union and one shared 32K candidate projection per logical batch; prefix-weighted micro losses and one optimizer update
training.amp: FP16 input/SID path with GradScaler; dense loss FP32, TF32 disabled
training.schedule: 1123 successful-update linear warmup then one global cosine over 269520 updates; no per-epoch reset; AMP skips do not advance
training.continuation: only this fresh run may resume its complete state; one epoch per submission, prior full validation acceptance required

early_stopping.counting: count every completed full validation from epoch 1; only strict Recall@5 improvement resets bad_epochs; permit metric stopping after at least 6 epochs
early_stopping.error_policy: nonfinite values, invalid artifacts or runtime failures stop immediately, regardless of min_epochs

validation.frequency: once after every complete training epoch in a separate two-GPU job
validation.checkpoint_loading: load model weights only on two GPUs; carry single-GPU optimizer, scheduler, scaler and RNG unchanged into an accepted post-validation checkpoint
